w.lore: VAMAXAEX practiced dodging the heavy iron cudgels of the workhouse overseers, which hardened their resolve to never be helpless again.
w.origin: Sold for a handful of copper coins to the pit-masters of the Sump

w.name: THEXIZ
w.lore: THEXIZ developed a freakish grip strength from climbing the quarry walls, carrying the heavy burden of a massacre they alone survived in the Lower Wards.
w.origin: Raised in the fighting pits beneath the butcher
